🗓 **TAWG Daily Catch-up**
_2026-09-13 23:00 → 2026-09-14 23:00 UTC_

## ⚡ **Highlights**

> **Spec framing affirmed** — the design's separation of the contribution DAG from realization records was recognized as a sharp structural choice, sharpening the group's shared vocabulary. [tg:tawg:4650]

> **Design blocker re-anchored** — a perceived missing piece was identified as drift from an existing committed design, redirecting effort back to a resolved path without adding new complexity. [tg:tawg:4681]

> **Validation Registry shape in public record** — the permissionless validator pattern and its uint8 0–100 response model were introduced to the ERC-8004 public thread, advancing a key design element into the open normative discussion. [ERC-8004 thread post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/398)

## 🤝 **What moved**

### ERC-8004 spec design
_Spec review and design discussion moved into a more grounded alignment phase._

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Reviewed** the spec's separation of the contribution DAG from realization records, affirming the framing as sharp and flagging a missing open question — this kind of close reading helps the group surface gaps before they harden into integration problems. [tg:tawg:4650]

- Jimmy Shi (@jimmyshi) **Clarified** why the group's narrowed approach to AI workload assessment is preferable to open-ended evaluation, grounding the shared methodology in a principled distinction that keeps contribution analysis reproducible across contributors. [tg:tawg:4677]

- Zexo (@zexoverz) **Reviewed** the merged codebase from a specific commit rather than from the review thread alone, engaging directly with carry-forward points to confirm the implementation stayed consistent with agreed design intent. [tg:tawg:4680]

- Baby Blue Viper (@babyblueviper1) **Resolved** a reported design blocker by identifying it as drift from the existing committed plan rather than a genuine gap, pointing back to an already-committed gist and restoring the team's design anchor. [tg:tawg:4681]

- A new post to the ERC-8004 Ethereum Magicians thread articulated the Validation Registry's permissionless shape and its uint8 0–100 response pattern, bringing this key design element into the open normative discussion. [ERC-8004 thread post](https://ethereum-magicians.org/t/erc-8004-trustless-agents/25098/398)

### post-commit verification
_Derivation attestation coordination advanced into active handoff._

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Coordinated** the post-commit comparison for a frozen derivation by confirming the disclosure was posted and requesting the agreed verification step, keeping the attestation workflow on track. [tg:tawg:4685]

- Pavlo (@pavlentyy82) **Shared** the complete materials needed for the post-commit verification, supplying the artifacts that allow the agreed comparison to proceed and close the verification loop. [tg:tawg:4687]

## 🚀 **Next up**

### 💡 **Ideas to follow**
- The open question raised during the spec DAG / realization-record review deserves a focused thread to prevent it from becoming a silent gap
- The Validation Registry uint8 0–100 shape discussion on the ERC-8004 thread may benefit from a synthesized response before the conversation moves past it

### ✅ **TODOs**
- Complete the post-commit comparison for the frozen derivation — materials are shared and ready
- Capture and formalize the open question from the spec review before the next design round

## 🤖 **Trusty's take**

> **Today's spark:** A perceived design blocker dissolved the moment the team pointed back to an already-committed design — the spec acted as shared memory and saved the group from reinventing a resolved decision.
>
> When the answer is already in the repo, the real move is trusting it — keep building on solid ground together! 🔍
